test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank to complete the idiom and make the sentence meaningful.

Her company's new product launch was a real _______________ squib.
solution:
The correct answer is: **damp**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"damp"** means slightly wet or lacking in enthusiasm or energy. (नम / उत्साहहीन)

 
 
• **Example: **The firewood was damp, making it difficult to start the campfire.
 
 
 
• In the context of the idiom "damp squib," it refers to something that is disappointing or fails to meet expectations. (निराशाजनक / उम्मीदों पर खरा न उतरने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **Everyone expected the fireworks display to be spectacular, but it turned out to be a damp squib.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **damp**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Dirty** (गंदा): Something that is unclean or impure.

 
 
• **Example:** His clothes were dirty after playing in the mud.
 
 
 
• **Best** (सर्वश्रेष्ठ): The highest quality or most excellent.
 
 
• **Example:** This is the best movie I have ever watched.
 
 
 
• **Dear** (प्रिय): Someone or something that is loved or cherished.
 
 
• **Example:** She wrote a letter to her dear friend.
